DESKTOP_FEATURES.title: Flip cards & active recall
DESKTOP_FEATURES.body: Lecture flashcards with flip, progress dots, and “Got it / Study again” so each session feels like a focused review—not endless scrolling.

DESKTOP_FEATURES.title: Quizzes & past papers
DESKTOP_FEATURES.body: Timed papers, MCQs linked to your curriculum, optional secure exam mode, and full review with explanations after you submit.

DESKTOP_FEATURES.title: Dr. Q — AI tutor
DESKTOP_FEATURES.body: Ask clinical and basic-science questions, attach files, and keep threads for deep dives—clearly labeled as a study aid, not a clinician.

DESKTOP_FEATURES.title: AI explanations on questions
DESKTOP_FEATURES.body: Where enabled, get instant AI breakdowns of stems and answer choices so you learn the “why,” not just the letter.

DESKTOP_FEATURES.title: Points, ranks & leaderboard
DESKTOP_FEATURES.body: Earn points from activity, level through ranks from Newbie to Elite, and compare with peers globally or within your semester.

DESKTOP_FEATURES.title: Organized curriculum
DESKTOP_FEATURES.body: University → semester → module → subject → lecture. One tree for videos, notes, attachments, flashcards, and question banks.

DESKTOP_FEATURES.title: Study Space
DESKTOP_FEATURES.body: Taskat, daily focus, sketching, and a PDF-friendly workflow—your on-site focus desk next to the rest of MedQs.

DESKTOP_FEATURES.title: Forums & study groups
DESKTOP_FEATURES.body: Global and semester forums, post saves, comments, and private groups so you are not studying in a silo.

DESKTOP_FEATURES.title: Question bank per lecture
DESKTOP_FEATURES.body: Practice MCQs tied to the same lectures as your flashcards—difficulty labels help you prioritize weak areas.
